we have computed all one-loop divergences for the effective action of a codimension-2 6D theory compactified on a rugby-ball geometry, and that we can use our results for any geometry that has codimension-two brane sources with conical geometry.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have calculated how to run with rugby balls.
we compute all the bulk loop effects that renormalize the bulk and brane couplings in 4D theories sourced by codimension-2 defects.
we have found a way to run the renormalization group with rugby balls.
The main takeaway from our work is that

bulk renormalization effects can be understood in terms of the renormalization group flow of a single 4D theory, and that bulk effects can be separated from brane effects in this flow by considering the flow of brane observables in a theory that is UV completed to include bulk fields.
bulk renormalization is a universal effect that does not depend on the boundary conditions at brane locations.

, in contrast to the situation with codimension-1 branes, the renormalization group flow of bulk and brane interactions in codimension-2 geometries can be calculated by integrating out only bulk fields.
